defect: The example calls rocksdb::ToString, which lives in the internal header util/string_util.h that the example (built only against public headers) does not include, so it fails to compile.
reason: The fix reverts exactly the two ToString calls this change introduced back to std::to_string to repair the example's compile failure.

defect: The fix removes the total_count == 0 early return (which skipped the WAL sync and hung the next writer) and handles callback-failed single writers when merging batches.
reason: The hanging early return was added later by 6f71d3b and the callback-failed handling postdates this change; its ByteSize assert was correct for the code at the time and is only dropped because of the fix's own restructuring.

defect: The new ChangePrefixExtractor test asserts BLOOM_FILTER_PREFIX_CHECKED counts that do not hold in the ROCKSDB_LITE build, so the test fails there.
reason: The fix only gates the counter assertions this change added on a non-LITE flag, repairing a test failure on a supported build configuration introduced by these lines.

defect: The fix enables backup/restore together with integrated BlobDB in db_stress by dropping backup_one_in from the incompatibility check.
reason: This is a feature enablement in the stress tool, not the repair of a defect introduced by this change (which only reformatted that condition).

defect: EnvWrapper::ReuseWritableFile is added without override while all neighbouring methods use it, which breaks the clang -Werror build (-Winconsistent-missing-override).
reason: The fix adds the missing override to exactly the method this change added, to repair the clang build.

defect: Enabling subcompactions with user-defined timestamps leaves the subcompaction bounds carrying the anchor's timestamp in the clipping iterator and input-file filtering, so versions of one user key can be split across subcompactions or dropped.
reason: This change removed the guard that disabled timestamp subcompactions and handled the bounds only for read_options, while the start_ikey/end_ikey code shown in its own diff still uses the timestamped bounds that the fix pads with kMaxTimestamp.

defect: The fix extends the compaction job test harness with block-based tables and new subcompaction tests.
reason: In this file the fix is test infrastructure and new tests, not a repair of anything the per-key-placement test change added.

defect: The fix makes MakeInputIterator's L0 file filtering compare subcompaction bounds without timestamps.
reason: When this change was made subcompactions were disabled for timestamp-enabled column families, so the timestamp-aware Compare was correct; it only became wrong when 56463d4 enabled timestamp subcompactions.

defect: Calling SetInjectUnsyncedDataLoss(false) after DB open toggles the global buffering flag, so a WAL opened during open mixes buffered and direct writes in TestFSWritableFile and becomes corrupt.
reason: The fix deletes exactly the SetInjectUnsyncedDataLoss(false) line this change added (and pins the mode per file), which caused the reported WAL corruption.

defect: DbStressListener::OnCompactionCompleted overrides a virtual method without override while OnFlushCompleted uses it, breaking the clang -Werror build.
reason: The fix adds override to the method this change added, repairing the -Winconsistent-missing-override compile error.

defect: The new WaitForCompactWithOptionToFlushAndCloseDB test increments plain int counters from sync-point callbacks running on background threads while the main thread reads them, a data race reported by TSAN.
reason: The fix turns exactly those counters added by this change into std::atomic_int to remove the race.

defect: After this change DeleteBackup no longer garbage-collects, but CorruptionsTest still deletes backup 2 and immediately creates a new backup 2 without GarbageCollect, so the new backup reuses stale files and the test fails intermittently.
reason: The change altered the deletion semantics and updated this test incompletely; the fix reorders the test to delete and garbage-collect before re-creating the backup.

defect: The new BlockReadCountTest declares KVMap kvmap, but KVMap only exists as stl_wrappers::KVMap, so table_test does not compile.
reason: The fix changes exactly the line this change added to stl_wrappers::KVMap to repair the build.

defect: The fix renames isCachable and compressionType to cachable and compression_type for naming consistency.
reason: A pure style rename; no defect is repaired.

defect: The new read-ahead switch is parsed as --readhead (typo) instead of --readahead, so the intended flag is rejected as invalid.
reason: The fix corrects the misspelled flag name in the line this change added.

defect: The new tool prints a uint64_t count with %d (format mismatch, undefined behaviour) and calls exit without including stdlib.h.
reason: The fix corrects the printf format and adds the missing include for code this change added.

defect: The new KeyMayExist test calls PutValues, which flushes the memtable, after which KeyMayExist cannot find the values, so the test fails.
reason: The fix makes the test skip the flush, repairing the failing test added by this change.

defect: InterpretOperationProperties uses std::map::emplace, which older supported gcc versions do not provide, causing compile errors.
reason: The fix replaces exactly the emplace calls this change added with insert to restore the build.

defect: The rewritten test calls the three-parameter gen_l0_kb lambda with only two arguments, which does not compile.
reason: The fix supplies the missing stride argument in the calls this change added (after an interim default-argument fix that broke the Mac build).

defect: The fix removes an unused, misspelled forward declaration class SystemClock_.
reason: The stray declaration was harmless; removing it is a cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: In this file the fix moves the range-tombstone seqnum loop into an UpdateRangeTombstoneSeqnums helper.
reason: The bugs the fix repairs (ignored tombstones and a leaked handle in MultiGetFilter) were introduced by a later change; this file only gets a refactor.

defect: The fix makes GetProperty wait for the sleeping background tasks to finish before they are destroyed.
reason: This change only removed the unused env_ member; the missing wait (use after scope) predates it.

defect: MakeBuilder passes a temporary ImmutableCFOptions(options) to NewTableBuilder, but the table builder keeps a reference to it, causing a use-after-free reported by ASAN.
reason: The fix replaces the temporary this change introduced with an ImmutableCFOptions that outlives the builder.

defect: The fix flushes the LogBuffer before decrementing the background job counters and adds bg_schedule_needed_ so jobs skipped at the thread limit are rescheduled.
reason: The data race comes from the later LogBuffer change, and the rescheduling flag is needed because of the fix's own lock release, not because of this deadlock fix.

defect: The new GetOptionsFromStringsTest compares unsigned option fields with signed int literals in ASSERT_EQ, which fails the Mac -Werror build on sign-compare.
reason: The fix adds unsigned suffixes and casts to exactly the assertions this change added to repair the Mac compile.

defect: The new file defines ParsedInternalKeyComparator in an anonymous namespace, duplicating the one in range_del_aggregator.cc, so the unity build fails with an ambiguous reference.
reason: The fix removes the duplicate struct this change added to repair the unity build.

defect: The new print_malloc_stats code calls rocksdb::DumpMallocStats, which is not available in ROCKSDB_LITE, breaking the LITE build.
reason: The fix wraps exactly the flag and call this change added in #ifndef ROCKSDB_LITE.

defect: The TEST_ helpers are compiled only under #ifndef NDEBUG, so make release fails to build because code still uses them.
reason: The fix changes this change's NDEBUG guard (here and in db_impl.h) to ROCKSDB_LITE to repair the release build.

defect: The fix repairs a broken constructor initializer list (a stray brace before deletes_check_filter_first) left by a bad merge.
reason: The code at this change compiled; the error came from the later merge commit 4a745a5 combining it with another branch.

defect: The fix makes the test destructor clear sync-point callbacks so a callback referencing a destroyed test's member is not fired by a later test.
reason: Replacing an empty destructor body with = default changed nothing; the leaked callback predates this modernizer change.

defect: The fix divides the filter partition size by 100, since block_size_deviation is a percentage.
reason: This change only dropped const from the casts; the missing /100 was already present before it.

defect: The fix applies the percentage correctly in the test's partition size and expected max filter size.
reason: This change only renamed table_opt to table_options_ and fixed a leak; the wrong percentage arithmetic was already present.

defect: Trimming iterators over iterate_upper_bound resets valid_ when the memtable iterator crosses the bound, so NeedToSeekImmutable always returns true and the tailing optimization is lost (a severe perf regression).
reason: The fix replaces this change's mechanism (removing NeedToRebuildTrimmed and smallest_file_key_bound, adding current_over_upper_bound_) to repair the regression it introduced.

defect: The fix is a feature commit that adds crash simulation on reopen and timestamps to db_stress, also changing the compression string initialization.
reason: It adds functionality rather than repairing a defect introduced by this warning cleanup; the build had no -Werror, so the char* literal only warned.

defect: This change shrinks prefix_buf from 6 to 5 bytes (and uses 5 in the new DBGet) while formatting a uint16_t + 1 that can take five digits, triggering the GCC 7 -Werror=format-truncation build failure.
reason: The fix restores the buffer size of 6 in exactly the lines this change added or shrank.

defect: The fix wraps pending_output_elem in a unique_ptr so ReleaseFileNumberFromPendingOutputs is never called with an uninitialized iterator.
reason: The crash is in IngestExternalFiles, where ReserveFileNumbersBeforeIngestion (from an earlier commit) can return early; CreateColumnFamilyWithImport always captures the iterator and only gets a matching type change.

defect: MutableCFOptions::Dump prints size_t fields with PRIu64, which is a format mismatch that breaks the Mac -Werror build.
reason: The fix changes the format specifiers this change added to %zu.

defect: Level1Trigger2 gives the two L1 files equal sizes, so which file the picker chooses depends on the STL sort's tie order and the test fails on some implementations.
reason: The fix makes file 66 strictly larger in the test this change added to remove the dependence on unspecified ordering.

defect: Dropping t_cnt from the lambda capture list while still using it inside the lambda fails to compile on MSVC (AppVeyor).
reason: The fix switches to default capture to repair the Windows build broken by this change's capture edit.

defect: The new CountSuccessiveMergeEntries writes !Compare(...) == 0, which triggers clang's logical-not-parentheses warning and fails the -Wall -Werror Mac build (the logic itself is equivalent to != 0).
reason: The fix rewrites exactly this added condition as Compare(...) != 0 to repair the Mac build.
